stats.name: MP regen
stats.note: MP restored every 4 ticks, through the status it brings.

stats.name: Defense
stats.note: A hit deals hit² ÷ (hit + 0.25 × Defense): nearly linear against big hits, never a blank. A status's own damage never meets it.

stats.name: Aggro
stats.note: Centred on 100 (a word n is 70 + 10n, a gear or formation step 10), never below 1. Foes pick party members by draw from ruleset.partyDraw: an ordinary unit draws 100, and every 25 Aggro doubles it (halves it below 100), from Aggro 25 (12.5) to 200 (1,600). The party picks among foes by ruleset.draw's curve: none draws more than 300 or less than 33.

regions.name: The Old Road

regions.text: Armored bones, wyrms you can't hit, ghosts your blows pass through, and Death with a bell.

regions.name: The Fire Mine
regions.text: Everything here burns, and the lord of the furnace casts a fire that ends parties.

regions.name: The Ice Pass
regions.text: Every fight asks what kind of hit you make, and a Titan of ice waits at the top.

regions.name: The Storm Tower
regions.text: Clouds of sparks, leeches that drink mana, and a queen behind a wall of drones.
